counting_rules: These are finite obligations, not executed test/node/native counts.
One case can support several requirements without being counted multiple times.
Later implementation inventories map every applicable case to exact nodes and retained evidence before execution.
Positive, supported-degraded, authentication-refusal, authority-refusal, malformed/unsupported and crash-unknown outcomes remain separate.
Diagnostics, failed attempts, old regressions and replay calls are never extra useful or native outcomes.
A requirement increments list is exactly the union of the owning increments of its case_ids, including final combined acceptance.
